$comment: Source of truth for everything purchasable. Syncs to Roblox via Open Cloud
riskTier encodes the currency firewall from docs/MONETIZATION.md section 2:
1 = sells coins or changes odds        (hidden from PRI-restricted players)
2 = multiplies coin income             (hidden from PRI-restricted players)
PRICES HERE ARE NOT DISPLAYED. The game always fetches price from
MarketplaceService at runtime so Regional Pricing, Price Optimization and
Roblox Plus discounts render correctly. These values are what we ask Roblox

vip.name: Nom Club VIP
vip.description: +1 Vault slot, offline earnings up to 4 hours, VIP skin and name tag, VIP lounge, and 2 free hatch skips every day.

coins2x.name: 2x Coins
coins2x.description: Doubles the coins every Nomling earns, forever.

biggerBase.name: Bigger Base
biggerBase.description: +6 pedestals, so six more Nomlings can earn at once.

turboIncubators.name: Turbo Incubators
turboIncubators.description: Eggs hatch 40% faster, plus one extra incubator.

fusionPro.name: Fusion Lab Pro
fusionPro.description: A second fusion slot, and fusions finish 30% faster.

vaultPlus.name: Vault+
vaultPlus.description: +2 Vault slots. Vaulted Nomlings can never be snatched.

autoCollect.name: Auto-Collect
autoCollect.description: Coins collect themselves. No more running to the pad.

luckyPaws.name: Lucky Paws
luckyPaws.description: Permanently improves your odds of rarer Nomlings by 25%. Live odds are always shown on the Odds panel.

oddsEffect.disclosure: Odds panel updates live while this is active.

creatorKit.name: Creator Kit
creatorKit.description: Photo filters, poses and backdrops for Creator Mode.

starterPack.name: Starter Pack
starterPack.description: One time only: the exclusive Bonded Nomling Sprinkle Sprout, plus 5 hatch skips.

skipAll.name: Finish All Eggs
skipAll.description: Finish every egg in every incubator right now.

serverHatchRush.name: Hatch Rush (whole server)
serverHatchRush.description: Everyone's eggs hatch twice as fast for 10 minutes. You get a thank-you banner.

serverFusionFrenzy.name: Fusion Frenzy (whole server)
serverFusionFrenzy.description: Everyone's fusions finish twice as fast for 10 minutes.

serverDisco.name: Disco Party (whole server)
serverDisco.description: Party lights and a dance emote for everyone, 5 minutes. Purely cosmetic.

coinPackS.name: Coin Snack
coinPackS.description: Coins equal to 30 minutes of your current income.

coinPackM.name: Coin Meal
coinPackM.description: Coins equal to 3 hours of your current income.

coinPackL.name: Coin Feast
coinPackL.description: Coins equal to 12 hours of your current income.

luck15.name: Lucky 15
luck15.description: Doubles your odds of rarer Nomlings for 15 minutes. Live odds are always shown on the Odds panel.

oddsEffect.disclosure: Odds panel updates live while this is active.

adReward_skip.name: Free Hatch Skip
adReward_skip.description: Reward for watching a video. Finishes one egg.
adReward_skip.$comment: Rewarded video reward. Stays disabled until the experience has 2,000+ unique monthly visitors and an approved questionnaire. Rewards MUST be developer products, never Robux.
